hook: A hiker was stuck in a gully 6,710 feet up.
narration: This helicopter was hovering beside a cliff, six thousand seven hundred feet up a mountain.
A hiker was stuck in a steep gully on Mount Larrabee, in Washington.
A Coast Guard crew from Port Angeles came in low, blasting the rocks with rotor wash.
Thin mountain air gives the rotors less lift, so a hover this high is much harder to hold.
outcome: The crew hoisted the hiker up out of the gully and flew off the mountain.
title: Hiker stuck in a gully at 6,710 feet
description:
A Coast Guard Air Station Port Angeles helicopter crew rescued a hiker from a steep gully on Mount Larrabee, Washington, on June 20, 2026, at an altitude of 6,710 feet.
